newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Mobil unit to sign Pequiven deal Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: Mobil unit to sign Pequiven deal Jan 9.

text.p: Mobil Chemical Co, a unit of Mobil Corp, will sign a joint venture deal on January 9 with Pequiven, the petrochemical wing of Venezuela's state owned Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) to develop a $1.6 billion olefins complex in Venezuela, a local industry official said Tuesday.

The project would include the construction of one olefins plant with an 830,000 tonnes per year capacity, two polyethylene plants each with a capacity of 480,000 tonnes per year and one plant producing up to 430,000 tonnes per year of glycol, said the official, who asked not to be named.
The complex at Jose on Venezuela's northeastern Caribbean coast is expected to start operating in 1999, he added.
